summary_1line: Vidura warns that gambling and Duryodhana’s arrogance will destroy the Kuru house, but Duryodhana angrily rebukes him and rejects the counsel.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vidura stands in the royal assembly warning the Kuru elders while Duryodhana sits beside the dice board, scowling defiantly.
Duryodhana angrily points at Vidura in the crowded court, accusing him of treachery while kings and warriors watch in tense silence.
